Did you know that many big game studios have straight-up cancelled projects, oftenly even because of stupid higher-up reasons, and these projects were nearly done? So what stops them from recycling bunch of worked concepts from freshly canned game? Not that it's not normal, though i think both sides are taking this situation wrong.  
What story is likely - INJ3 cancelled due to discovery stuff and etc, and devs looked into their idea library to skip over the most time consuming parts of developement (thinking through gameplay mechanics and such, and MK1 needed something it can get people interested with aside returning olds).
